notes.title: Desolatium: Prologue First Anniversary!
notes.notes:
It's been a year since the release of Desolatium: Prologue! Thank you to everyone who played it and who is waiting for the final game to be launched, we can't wait to show you everything!!

Thank you to everyone who took their time to leave us a review, this is one of the best ways to support indie games 🙌 

If you still haven't played, it's the time! (It's free so there are no excuses ;)

We also want to remind you about out current demo of Desolatium: the first two chapters of the final game. Let us know if you played, and please add Desolatium to your wishlist if you still haven't, you help us a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474900/Desolatium/

PS: We are working full-time on Desolatium, we know there are still some bugs to fix here (achievements, VR, etc.), but we are 100% focused on the development of the final game. We will keep you updated with any change in the prologue.

Thanks for being there and supporting us!

Superlumen Team,

notes.title: Discover some of the references to LOVECRAFT and other horror classics!
notes.notes:
There is just one week left to [b]Desolatium: Prologue release (June 4)[/b], so we thought about giving you some clues about the game. 

[h3]As you know, Desolatium is based on Lovecraft Mythos and therefore, it’s full of references to the lovecraftian universe, but also to other horror classics. [/h3]

In Desolatium: Prologue you not only have to be aware of everything that happens, but of everything that you see. Every single thing is there for a reason, so if you want to discover some references that you may missed or keep them in mind before playing, stay here and keep reading.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571888/4088b78ae24da4b940c0b500e0cf83f863a49752.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The first reference to the Lovecraft universe is [b]Ulthar[/b], a village in The Dreamlands of Earth created by him (H. P. Lovecraft). The cobbled streets of Ulthar seem to be some of the most pleasant in the mythos, and so are in the game, right? Also, have you heard those meows? 

[*] You may see a [b]silver key[/b]. Does it sound familiar to you? It is an ancient artifact, the use of which unlocks gates of space and time and allows access to remote times and places of the universe. It was last in the possession of Randolph Carter, who used it to travel through the Ultimate Gate. Why is it on the game? 

[*] There is also a painting of a Ghoul, signed by [b]R. U. Pickman[/b]. He is a recurring character in H. P. Lovecraft’s stories, a painter whose paintings are based on a terrifying theme plagued by monsters. 
[/list]

Let’s go now to the cemetery. You may spend some time looking for clues and finding names on the graves. These are some: 

[list]
[*] [i]“Sutter Cane, your books took you to the top and then became your downfall. You will always live in its pages and beyond”[/i] – The mad writter from the lovecraftian movie [b]"In the Mouth of Madness."[/b] 

[*] [i]"Carol Anne Freeling. Always happy, always playing. You can finally go towards the light”[/i] - Carol Anne is the little girl from "[b]Poltergeist[/b]." 

[*] “[i]Jack Torrance. Husband and father. Overlook will always remember you."[/i] - Jack is the “beloved” father of the movie "[b]The Shining.[/b]" 

[*] [i]“Abdul Alhazred. The mad sorcerer. It sounds sinister."[/i] He is a recurring character in the works of H.P. Lovecraft. He is frequently cited as the author of the fabled “[b]Necronomicon[/b]”, the original title of which was "Kitab Al-Azif", a text about arcane knowledge and ritual magic, the knowledge of which can lead to madness or even death. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571888/9366fc1e06d59dd5b90b8903a38ce011245f5382.png[/img]

These are only some of the references, but there are many more. Will you be able to find all of them?  

If you want another post with the rest of the references, we will do it soon! Tell us your favourite one through our social media: 

[list]
[*] Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/desolatium]@desolatium[/url]
[*] Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/desolatium]Desolatium[/url]
[*] Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/desolatium/]@desolatium[/url]
[/list]


Desolatium: Prologue will be available on Steam, Itchio, Gamejolt and VivePort, soon on Oculus. 

See you in Ulthar!
